subject.title: fix(ci): keep markdown-only PR jobs off Blacksmith

question: Should maintainers adopt the early hosted `ci_scope` gate as the preferred fix for Markdown-only PR CI, after rebasing it onto current main?
rationale: The patch changes CI runner routing and is currently merge-conflicting; automation can inspect correctness but should not choose the permanent CI capacity strategy or resolve stale workflow conflicts without maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase and review scope gate
options.body: Keep this PR as the preferred candidate, rebase it over current main, rerun workflow validation and hosted Markdown-only proof, then review for merge.

options.title: Choose trigger-level skipping instead
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if maintainers intentionally prefer a `paths-ignore`/docs-workflow strategy despite the risk of dropping checks.

options.title: Defer the CI routing change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and pause this PR if Blacksmith capacity policy should not change right now.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review scope gate
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the preferred candidate, rebase it over current main, rerun workflow validation and hosted Markdown-only proof, then review for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI runner-registration and routing commits make this the strongest available owner signal for the strategy choice.
